summary.name: Seafile
summary.one_liner: Seafile is an open source, self-hosted file sync and share solution that lets you sync, access, and collaborate on files on your own server or private cloud.
keywords: open source file sync and share
use_cases: self-host a private file sync and share server
sync files across devices on your own server
share files with password-protected expiring links
collaborate on documents and a team wiki
organize files with custom properties, tags and views
keep audit logs and file history for compliance
summary.what_it_does: Seafile provides file syncing and sharing that can run on your own server or private cloud. It supports custom file properties with table, gallery, kanban and map views, plus multi-level tagging with optional AI-generated descriptions and tags. Sharing offers read/write, read-only and preview permissions, with per-folder controls and password, expiration and access settings for share links. It includes SeaDoc collaborative docs with real-time co-editing and Markdown support, a team wiki with nested subpages, online viewing and editing of Office and text files, and features such as file history recovery and audit logs.
notable: Open source and self-hosted on your own server or private cloud
SeaDoc real-time collaborative docs with revision and review workflow
Table, gallery, kanban and map views driven by file properties
